widget.prompt: Count the squares in this 4 by 5 array.

commonCounts.feedback: That adds the rows and columns instead of counting every square in the rectangle.
That counts a single row. All 4 rows belong to the total.

widget.lowFeedback: Keep counting — every square in all 4 rows belongs to the total.
widget.highFeedback: The grid holds only 20 squares; counting past that means a square was counted twice.

predict.prompt: Why is mixed practice harder than one table in order?

options.label: You cannot predict the next answer

predict.reveal: In a table each product is the last plus the group size. Mixed order removes that crutch and tests real recall.
